title: Vaporesso Luxe X & XR Replacement Pods - 2 Pack
description: The Vaporesso Luxe XR is a premium 40W pod device with a futuristic design, a long-lasting 1500mAh battery, and the versatility to enjoy both MTL and RDL vaping with dedicated pods and replaceable GTX Mesh Coils . These replacement Vaporesso Luxe XR refillable pods employ a replaceable coil system that uses Vaporesso’s celebrated GTX mesh coils for a flavoursome cross between a RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) and an MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape. The pods and are held in place with strong magnets and have a capacity of 2ml. They can be refilled from a sealed port at the bottom. You can also rotate the pod 180-degrees for a tighter or airier airflow . Vaporesso’s new Corex technology, which consists of a Morph-Mesh coil structure with Cumulus Cotton wicking, ensures incredible flavour whichever coil you choose, while SSS Leak-Resistant technology helps prevent leaks and condensation building up in the pod. For a version of the Luxe XR that uses fixed-coil disposable pods, see the Vaporesso Luxe X Replacement Pods . Please Note: These pods DO NOT come with coils.
